system.description: Poison from vitriol, agata venom, crushed pearls, and Kimbery's salt. Delivered by ingestion or wounds. Against elementals and Dragon-Blooded: Damage 8L/minute, Toxicity 5, Penalty -5, plus one additional Willpower per Charm used for one day. Against all others: Damage 6L/minute, Toxicity 4, Penalty -4. Costs Resources 3 in Malfeas. Infernal Alchemy procedure.
